name: T12-WF10 - AI Next Best Action Agent

parameters.content:
## 1. Protected Backend Dispatch
NestJS authorizes requester and resource, creates WorkflowRun, then calls this webhook.

## 2. CRM Evidence
Load authoritative profile, qualification/score, interactions and follow-up/segment policy.

## 3. Candidate Allowlist & AI Ranking
Backend supplies allowed actions; AI can rank/explain only those actions.

## 4. Persist Recommendation & Approval
Backend stores recommendation and owns ReviewTask lifecycle.

nodes.name: Code: Validate Entity Reference
nodes.notes: The webhook must use the CRM Internal Webhook Header credential. Only NestJS may dispatch; browsers must never call it.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { entityType: $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.entityType, entityId: $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.entityId, workflowRunId: $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.workflowRunId, n8nExecutionId: String($exec.id) } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Get Entity Profile
nodes.notes: PROVISIONAL API: not present in current API contract. Backend must enforce WorkflowRun/entity/requester scope.

parameters.url: ={{ ($env.BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL || 'http://localhost:3000') + '/api/v1/internal/n8n/next-best-actions/intelligence-context?entityType=' + $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.entityType + '&entityId=' + $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.entityId + '&workflowRunId=' + $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.workflowRunId }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Get Qualification and Score
nodes.notes: PROVISIONAL API: returns current qualification and canonical score when applicable.

parameters.url: ={{ ($env.BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL || 'http://localhost:3000') + '/api/v1/internal/n8n/next-best-actions/interactions?entityType=' + $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.entityType + '&entityId=' + $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.entityId + '&workflowRunId=' + $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.workflowRunId }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Get Interaction History
nodes.notes: PROVISIONAL API: bounded and access-scoped interaction evidence.

parameters.url: ={{ ($env.BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL || 'http://localhost:3000') + '/api/v1/internal/n8n/next-best-actions/follow-up-segment-context?entityType=' + $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.entityType + '&entityId=' + $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.entityId + '&workflowRunId=' + $node['Code: Validate Entity Reference'].json.workflowRunId }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Get Follow-up and Segment Context
nodes.notes: PROVISIONAL API: must expose authoritative enrollment/segment state and the backend action allowlist.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $node["Code: Generate Candidate Actions"].json.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: AI Rank and Explain Actions
nodes.notes: GEMINI_API_KEY is read from n8n environment. Do not embed credentials in workflow JSON.

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Save Recommendation
nodes.notes: PROVISIONAL API: not yet listed in API contract. Must persist recommendation and deduplicate by workflowRunId.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { workflowRunId: $node['Code: Validate Action'].json.workflowRunId, entityType: $node['Code: Validate Action'].json.entityType, entityId: $node['Code: Validate Action'].json.entityId, recommendationId: $node['HTTP Request: Save Recommendation'].json.recommendationId || $node['HTTP Request: Save Recommendation'].json.data?.id, idempotencyKey: $node['Code: Validate Action'].json.workflowRunId } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Create Review and Notification
nodes.notes: PROVISIONAL API: backend must create/reuse ReviewTask. n8n never changes the CRM entity or executes the recommendation.

main.node: HTTP Request: Get Qualification and Score
HTTP Request: Get Follow-up and Segment Context
HTTP Request: AI Rank and Explain Actions
HTTP Request: Create Review and Notification

description: Owner: Tuấn Anh. Protected internal webhook. AI may only rank backend-allowlisted actions. Several dedicated internal APIs are provisional and require backend implementation before activation. Atomic WorkflowRun claim is folded into the entity-context request; the graph has exactly 12 functional nodes.
